paras: Crypto payments firm <g>Mesh</g> partnered with Visa so people can pay with crypto and stablecoin balances held in wallet apps.
<u>No separate crypto card.</u> A Visa credential is set up in the wallet behind the scenes, and Mesh converts the crypto to cash at the moment you pay.
Merchants get paid through Visa as usual, with no change at checkout.
slides.source: Mesh / Visa via The Block, Cointelegraph

paras: Launch date, supported coins and the first wallet apps have <r>not been announced</r>. They come "as rollout plans are finalized."
<u>"Crypto never had a spending problem. It has a last-mile problem," says Mesh CEO Bam Azizi.</u>
Mesh also powers PayPal's "Pay with Crypto".
